items.abstract: <jats:p>Lake Bled, Slovenia was investigated from 1975 until 1982. Artificial inflow,hypolimnetic outflow and diversion of sewage have a certain effect on the appearance and number of O. rubescens. Fourier analysis was used to find periodic components in data and stepwise regression to evaluate the dependence of O. rubescens on variations in temperature, phosphorus, nitrate and sodium. In the stepwise regression equation temperature is entered on the first step, then Na+ and finally NO-3. Prior to the installation of two further tubes for hypolimnene outflow and the diversion of sewage, phosphorus was not significant at the 0,5 level of probability.</jats:p>
